seo.title: MBABANE — LUSITO KUBANTFU LABANGENALIKHAYA - No Home Help
seo.description: Tinombolo letihloliwe telusito loluphutfumako, indzawo yekuhlala, kudla, imphilo, kuphepha nemtsetfo eMbabane.

page.heading: MBABANE — LUSITO KUBANTFU LABANGENALIKHAYA
page.urgent: Nangabe kunengoti lephutfumako, shayela tinsita tesimo lesiphutfumako letibhalwe ngentasi. Timo tendzawo tingaphazamisa tinsita.
page.notice: Lwati, tikhatsi, imigomo netindzawo kungashintja. Shayela ungakahambi. Loluhlu alucinisekisi umbhede, kudla, imali, kwelashwa noma umsebenti.
page.intro: Cala ngensita lefanele ngentasi. Shano kutsi useMbabane, kutsi unayo yini indzawo lephephile kulobusuku, netidzingo temphilo, kuphepha, kukhubateka noma kuvikelwa kwemntfwana.
page.footer: Umthombo ukhona kulokunye nalokunye. Indzawo yekulala ayicinisekiswa.

entries.title: National emergency helplines
entries.description: National emergency helplines iniketa noma ihlele lusito lwe lusito loluphutfumako eMbabane. Tsintsana nabo kucinisekisa imigomo, indzawo nekutsi lusito luyatfolakala.
entries.phone: Police 999; ambulance 977; fire 933; women and children 951; child helpline 116
entries.how_to_access: Shayela noma ubuke iwebhusayithi lesemtsetfweni ungakahambi. Buta lusito lolukhona namuhla nemibhalo ledzingekako.
